message: feat(unified): U09 共同请求队列、公平轮转和legacy屏障
rulings: Only internal C++ descriptors were extended; old176B/new128B wire ABI and program identities remain unchanged. Trusted pure WorkSource lowers admitted plans lazily; one head and one active item per request, no eager million-job expansion.

Live requests8, process pending32, retained completions64 and explicit-forget idempotency index256. GPU active1. Completed/ACKed/retired GPU boundary is required before rotation; queue deadline never preempts active hardware.

CPU has one4-range borrowed reservation. Claim forbids double execution/early release. Pool drains on cancellation and returns claim, scheduler alone retires its token; shared original GELU expression and RNE/flags retained.

Cancelled late CPU/GPU completion cannot revive a request. Failed lowering/deadline/runtime reason remains queryable. Failed completion allocation retains original active state and can deliver the same completion once.

Legacy keeps the full transaction barrier; actual legacy job/quiescent/retirement evidence integration remains U10. Source admission, real resource leases, daemon/socket and actual backend dispatch are not claimed by scheduler fixture tests.

Five shared implementation objects linked to9 tests per configuration. Validation only uses -g1; default-g and O2/no-fast-math/fp-contract-off retained. Matching OUT dry-run performs zero recompiles, no unmeasured speedup claim.
